thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a console/UI rollout today at 10:30 PT. Canary 5% for 15m, then ramp if green. Will run CDN invalidation as part of the switch. @sam can you own smoke checks?
jon: I can be onsite for rollback if needed. What time zone is that for eu folks? (10:30 PT = 18:30 UTC)
maria: yes 18:30 UTC. Canary traffic will be routed to new build in us-west-2 only.
lee: quick QA: do we have any breaking CSS vars or analytics changes in this build? I saw a small analytics event rename in the PR.
maria: analytics rename is behind a feature flag, not live. CSS update is scoped to /settings only. No layout-wide changes.
sam: ok I'll run the smoke checklist and report within the 15m canary window. Will validate login, settings, billing flow, and plugin list.
anya: I'll watch Sentry and dashboard traffic for error spikes and event sampling. ping me if you need me to hold rollout.
jon: what's the CDN invalidation plan? full wildcard purge or targeted? full purge will be expensive.
maria: targeted: invalidate /assets/console/* and /console/*.html only. We'll avoid full site purge.
lee: also remember the cache-control header change we merged last week. Should be fine, but double-check edge TTL is 60s for html.
sam: I have a small script to hit the canary hosts and run smoke curl checks, I'll post logs.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job #deploy-1765420001 queued by maria for 2026-03-17T10:30:00-07:00
jon: rollback readiness — which commit do we roll back to? Keep previous tagged release `v1.42.3` pinned in the release job.
maria: yes deploy job keeps `v1.42.3` as fallback. We'll keep the canary for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then 100% if no issues.
sam: starting canary smoke checks now (pre-deploy): auth smoke ok, basic pages render, console assets served from s3/cdn.
sam: post-deploy smoke script (snippet):
```
curl -sSf -I https://console.redwood.ai/ | grep -i "cache-control"
curl -sSf https://console.redwood.ai/settings | grep "Settings"
```

maria: CDN purge command (ops key required):
```
curl -X POST https://api.fastcdn.example/v1/purge \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FASTCDN_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"paths":["/assets/console/*","/console/*.html"]}'
```

anya: noted — I'll watch error rate and event count. If Sentry errors > 5/min or 5% increase in page load failures, we abort.
jon: ping me when you start the 50% ramp so I can stand by.
maria: starting deploy in 5m. @sam will post canary results. @anya watch Sentry. @jon on rollback standby. :thumbsup:
sam: canary started — initial smoke all green. Posting condensed logs in #eng-releases after run.
deploy-bot: deploy job #deploy-1765420001 started: stage=canary percent=5
sam: canary smoke pass at +3m. no JS errors, assets 200, login ok.
anya: Sentry noise looks normal, no spike. APM traces ok.
maria: proceeding to 50% in 2m unless objections.
jon: good to go from my side.
maria: ramping to 50% now.
deploy-bot: deploy job #deploy-1765420001 update: stage=canary percent=50
sam: running secondary smoke suite against 50% — will take ~7m.
anya: still clean. analytics events look as expected.
sam: 50% smoke pass. No regressions.
maria: going to full. executing CDN invalidation after traffic switch.
deploy-bot: deploy job #deploy-1765420001 update: stage=full percent=100
maria: CDN purge kicked. Sam, can you sanity-check the main html TTLs post-purge?
sam: html TTL header shows 60s edge TTL. assets returning 200 from CDN. final smoke all green.
anya: monitoring for 10m post-full — will call abort if any regression shows.
jon: good job team. If anything odd pops up ping me and I'll roll back to `v1.42.3`.
maria: thanks all — tagging this thread with the deploy logs. closing once 10m clean window passes. :party:
